summary_and_action_plan.executive_summary: ShiftManager demonstrates strong security architecture, good role-based access control, and solid multi-tenancy enforcement. However, there are significant inconsistencies in UI styling (Bootstrap vs custom CSS), incomplete localization (3 major pages entirely in English), and missing navigation elements (breadcrumbs, back buttons). The application is production-ready but needs polish for international deployment and enterprise-level UX.
